item: Row 288 tail: the country migration tests run on the app's engine
summary: test_country_migration and test_country_alternates now build their stores with app_sqlite_engine (WAL, foreign keys on). The earlier failures were the tests' own open connections: under WAL an idle connection holds the store and the migration's exclusivity check is right to refuse (lane F, row 300). Every read now closes its connection (a _read_form helper, contextlib.closing), the alternates corpus uses NullPool so a session's connection closes with it, and the deliberate holders that prove the refusal stay. No product change, no gc.collect. Bare-engine ratchet 41 -> 38. test_article_dates, test_pdf_import, test_reindex_pipeline and test_www_stamp still wait on open PRs #2031 and #2038.
